title: Post Graduate Certificate in Strategic Project Management & Leadership
seo_title: PG Certificate Strategic Project Management IIMV | Accredian
description: Embark on a 10 month learning journey in Project Planning, Risk Management, and Project Procurement.

content.title: who should join
points: Aspiring & Current Project Managers: Gain skills to lead projects effectively.
Team Leaders: Improve planning and execution capabilities.
Functional Managers (Ops, IT, Marketing): Streamline project workflows and align with business goals.
Entrepreneurs: Oversee initiatives and startups efficiently.
Consultants: Adopt structured methodologies for client projects.
Business Analysts: Transition into project management roles.

content.title: program snapshot
points: 12 Modules - Project Planning, Risk Management, and Project Procurement
Learn from esteemed IIM Visakhapatnam faculty and top industry professionals.
Campus Immersions: One Campus Immersion of 2 days (Opt.)

curriculum.title: Foundations of Strategic Project Management
points: Program vs. portfolio vs. project management
Role of Project Leader in Value Creation

curriculum.title: Project Scope, Scheduling & Cost Management
points: Advanced Scheduling Techniques (CPM, PERT, Agile Sprints)
Budgeting, cost estimation techniques & Earned Value Management (EVM)
Financial Metrics for Projects: ROI, NPV, Cost-Benefit Analysis

curriculum.title: Risk, Quality & Resource Management
points: Resource Allocation, Optimization & Team Capacity Planning

curriculum.title: Communication, Influence & Stakeholder Leadership
points: Influencing without authority in complex organizations
Negotiation & conflict resolution for project leaders

curriculum.title: Governance, Procurement & Compliance
points: Ethics, Compliance & Sustainability in Project Leadership

curriculum.title: Capstone Project
points: Participants Will Design & Execute a Comprehensive Project Plan Aligned with Organizational Strategy, Integrating Scope Definition, Scheduling, Budgeting & Risk Management. They Will Apply Stakeholder Engagement, Executive Reporting & Implement Governance & Procurement Strategies. The Project Will Include Stakeholder Engagement, Executive Reporting, Performance Monitoring & a Final Closure Report Capturing Lessons Learned & Measurable Value Delivered.

curriculum.title: Project Analytics & Data-Driven Project Management
points: Introduction to Descriptive, Predictive & Prescriptive Analytics
Using Analytics for Forecasting Risks, Costs & Schedules
Case Studies: Analytics-Driven Project Successes & Failures

curriculum.title: AI & GenAI for Project Leaders
points: AI & GenAI Fundamentals for Non-Technical Leaders
AI Applications in Project Planning & Execution
Generative AI for Reporting, Documentation & Communication
Future of Project Leadership with AI

curriculum.title: Capstone Project
points: Participants Will Design & Execute a Comprehensive, Enterprise-Aligned Project Integrating Scope, Schedule, Cost, Risk & Quality Frameworks. They Will Apply Governance, Procurement & ESG Strategies, Optimize Resources, Leverage Analytics & AI Tools & Engage Stakeholders Effectively. Deliverables Include a Detailed Project Plan, GenAI-Powered Insights, a Board-Ready Presentation with Performance Monitoring, Lessons Learned & Measurable Organizational Value Delivered.

content.title: Is prior experience in HR required for program enrollment?
content: This program is specifically crafted for mid-level professionals looking to advance their careers and expand their sectoral knowledge. It is intended for individuals with foundational industry experience.

content.title: How much time does one need to spend?
content: Ideally, 30 minutes of preparation time is recommended each day, but students can allocate time according to their own schedules. They can choose to practice, read, or watch videos. Additionally, students must attend live classes on weekends. The schedule for these classes will be shared in advance.

content.title: What is the duration of the program?
content: The duration of the program is 10 months.

content.title: How is the IIM Visakhapatnam's Post Graduate Certificate in Strategic Project Management & Leadership different?
content: ### Three things that make this program world class:

- **Advanced Pedagogical Approach:** IIM Visakhapatnam's advanced pedagogical approach, supported by its rank of 26th by NIRF, ensures a cutting-edge, innovative, and effective learning experience. This method fosters deep understanding and real-world application of Artificial intelligence  concepts.

- **Bridging Ideas to Industry:** IIM Visakhapatnam bridges academic ideas to real-world industry applications through a structured framework, fostering practical learning and career readiness. This ensures that students are not only theoretically knowledgeable but also equipped to tackle contemporary business challenges effectively.
- **Accredian Career Center:** Aligned with our mission to cultivate the leaders of tomorrow, the Accredian Career Center empowers you to confidently launch your career.

content.title: Tell me more about Career Assistance?
content: You will have access to Accredian Career Support module. This module includes comprehensive career development sessions aimed at enhancing your job profile and helping you excel in your interviews.
